skill.name: gate-mcp-installer
skill.description: Installs and configures the mcporter CLI so OpenClaw can connect to Gate MCP, then verifies available tools.
skill.summary: Install, configure, and verify Gate MCP access for OpenClaw through mcporter.
skill.author: gate

security_audit.summary: The hidden-file alerts are false positives because they reference the documented OpenClaw skill directory, and the Markdown backtick alerts are formatting. Real risks remain: the skill runs a bash installer, installs an unpinned global npm package, and configures a persistent third-party MCP endpoint.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the mcporter version, document package provenance, and verify integrity before global installation.
Disclose what data may be sent to the endpoint and offer a dry-run or manual configuration path.
Show the planned install and config changes before execution and require explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: No check-only workflow in the installer
remediation.suggestion: Add a verification mode that checks npm, mcporter, config, and connectivity without changing state.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Global Package Installation
semantic_findings.description: The installer runs a global npm installation for mcporter without pinning a version or verifying package integrity. A compromised or changed package could execute with the user permissions available to npm.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script directly installs or updates mcporter globally through npm. The package is not pinned and no integrity check is present in the installer.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent External MCP Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The installer adds a persistent home-scope Gate MCP configuration pointing to an external endpoint. Future MCP usage may send tool requests or query context to that third-party service.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The endpoint and config command are explicit in both the script and documentation. The risk is contextual because the endpoint is intended, but it persists beyond initial installation.

content.value_statement: Gate MCP setup requires installing mcporter, adding an endpoint, and checking connectivity. This skill automates those steps and gives clear troubleshooting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether npm is available before installation starts.
Installs or updates the mcporter CLI globally through npm.
Adds the Gate MCP endpoint with mcporter using home scope.
Verifies Gate MCP connectivity by listing available tool schemas.
Prints setup status, installed versions, and common usage prompts.
Provides manual installation and troubleshooting steps when automation fails.
limitations: Requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
Uses a global npm installation that may need local permissions.
Only configures the public Gate MCP endpoint.
Does not guarantee endpoint uptime or market data accuracy.

use_cases.title: Set Up Gate MCP
use_cases.description: Install mcporter, add the Gate endpoint, and verify that OpenClaw can reach MCP tools.

use_cases.title: Verify An Existing Setup
use_cases.description: Check the installed CLI, saved Gate configuration, and tool listing before using market data workflows.

use_cases.title: Recover From Setup Errors
use_cases.description: Diagnose missing commands, configuration problems, and connection failures with guided repair steps.

prompt_templates.title: Install Gate MCP
prompt_templates.prompt: Install Gate MCP for OpenClaw and verify it works.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether Gate MCP is configured correctly. Report each check and the next fix if one fails.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Connection Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Gate MCP cannot connect. Diagnose npm, mcporter, config, and network status before changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Reinstall And Validate
prompt_templates.prompt: Update mcporter, reconfigure Gate MCP only if needed, then list available tools and summarize changed settings.

output_examples.output: npm was available, mcporter was installed, the Gate endpoint was added, and MCP tools were verified.
The local setup exists, but endpoint verification failed. Check network access and retry when the service is reachable.

best_practices: Review the installer script before running it.
Confirm global npm installation is acceptable for your environment.
Run verification after installation and keep endpoint configuration visible to administrators.
anti_patterns: Running the installer in locked-down production shells without approval.
Using the skill where Node.js and npm are not allowed.
Assuming MCP tool results replace independent market or security review.

faq.question: Does this skill need API keys?
faq.answer: No. It uses a public Gate MCP endpoint and does not store credentials.

faq.question: What does it install?
faq.answer: It installs the mcporter CLI globally through npm.

faq.question: Can it run without internet access?
faq.answer: No. It needs network access for npm installation and endpoint verification.

faq.question: Can I verify before changing configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a health check before requesting installation or reconfiguration.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should security reviewers inspect?
faq.answer: Review the global npm install, the external endpoint, and the home-scope MCP configuration.
